snippet.title: VonGarland Castle : Beyond Blood -  Announcement Trailer - coming soon - Wishlist On Steam
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578290/VonGarland_Castle__Beyond_Blood/
VonGarland Castle : Beyond Blood

trailer music by:
https://marcvdmeulen.com/royalty-free-horror-music

Ransom VonGarland must journey to Mayhem Island and the ruins of VonGarland Castle to find her brother and uncover the truth of what Plasmadine corporation is doing on the island 

VGBB 
is a survival horror action platformer with some Metroidvania elements. Think super Metroid meets RE4.
you must fight your way through hordes of enemies and bosses and solve puzzles to reach VonGarland castle.

find keys & items to help you reach new areas of Mayhem Island. 
discover new weapons to defeat enemies more easily.
conserve ammo by taking on enemies in close combat.

enter a world of survival horror
